events.title: AI provider: slingring · HACK26_GPT_6_ASTRA / HACK26_GPT_5_6_LUNA
Reading the product (RAG)
Grounded spec built
events.reasoning: The evidence shows that Procol’s product already handles multi‑stage sourcing events, vendor invitations and award flows, so the “minimum decrement” rule is already enforced by the backend contract and frontend test cases. However, the PRD’s phone‑number requirement (any 10‑digit number) is not fully implemented: the backend only checks string length, not that the characters are digits. This creates a spec‑vs‑product gap that should be covered by a test verifying that non‑numeric characters are rejected even when the length is correct. Adding such a validation test will align the implementation with the documented specification.

deltas.prdSays: Accept any 10-digit number; reject malformed input politely (PRD §4.3, §5).
deltas.productDoes: The API checks phone LENGTH (rejects 9 or 11 digits) but NOT that characters are digits — it accepts a 10-char value containing letters. The frontend enforces digits-only, so the API is more lenient than the UI.
